units.translation: ⟦1⟧: they exist entirely for ruin (125); therefore they have no intercourse, and Tartarus is their dwelling-place, the opposite of bright Olympus. Tartarus is, as in Hesiod, the actual black hell, beneath Hades, ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, although one should not expect too precise a topography of the afterlife in Aeschylus (as, for example, in Plato, Gorg. 524 A, Phaid. 113 E, Rep. X, 616 A). ⟦4⟧ like ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧.
beneath Hades, receiver of the dead, into boundless Tartarus
objects of hatred to the temperate

V. 75 ⟦1⟧ cannot be connected with ⟦2⟧ 77; therefore ⟦3⟧ is "even", but ⟦4⟧, as little as elsewhere in Aeschylus (⟦5⟧. 790. ⟦6⟧. 737), means "dry land" (⟦7⟧ 240) in contrast to water, but rather continent (Asia and Europe in those passages), thus: "indeed through a whole long-stretched continent." To this attaches ⟦8⟧ 77 ("and also") exactly as at 250 ⟦9⟧.

In V. 76 I write with G. Hermann ⟦1⟧' ⟦2⟧, for which he refers to ⟦3⟧ c ⟦4⟧; but then one must also carry through the similarity and write ⟦5⟧ (for the resolution cf. ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧. ⟦8⟧ with accusative is very much in Aeschylus's manner, e.g. ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧. Thus ⟦11⟧, through one land of the continent after another. ⟦12⟧ (-⟦13⟧) finally must be ⟦14⟧ or ⟦15⟧: the former means "standing firm", the latter indeed "going", but is not attested from the tragedians; since, however, besides Homer, Pindar (Ol. 14, 16) also has it, one must prefer it with G. Hermann.
land after land he is driven
and he wanders fasting along the shore sand
⟦1⟧ "dwelling-places" of islands, like ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ Euboea, Ar. ⟦4⟧. 251 of Sicily; the scholiast on Ar. traces this back to Homer, Ξ 230 ⟦5⟧ . . ⟦6⟧.

One expects rather ⟦1⟧, like ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧: but the sense is: do not become slack anywhere before the time (i.e., from the repeated occasions for it); but when you come to Athens, then etc. Paley correctly compares 88 ⟦4⟧. ⟦5⟧ like ⟦6⟧ 196, passive (wrongly ⟦7⟧ Schol.); the driving Erinyes are the ⟦8⟧, as in the case of Io the ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧, in the case of ships the storm wind, ⟦11⟧; the accusative as ⟦12⟧.. ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧.
do not weary your foot beforehand
let not fear overcome your mind
